title: 仕事納めと年末の職場
subject_en: Year-end workplace scenes with faceless office workers (plain heads, muted clothing), each a small complete scene with a few props. Include no company names. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: 大掃除・請求書・仕事納めの挨拶・忘年会など、年末の職場場面12点の素材です。社内報や資料、ブログに使えます。
